title: Собрать generated semantic manifest и exact-set PHP/Dart drift gate
summary: Построить digest-qualified `semantic-profile/v1` из normative `2026-09`, снять фактические профили PHP/Dart и сделать missing/extra/mismatch красным CI-гейтом без генерации SDK source.
why: Current PHP/Dart constants are manually maintained and already have unequal literal coverage; PHP↔Dart equality alone is not normative. DR-02 rejected SDK codegen but explicitly left structural freshness as the replacement gate. `RAG:—`.

include: Deterministic manifest extractor; schema/version/source digests; SDK profile contract/exporters; exact-set comparator for codes/categories/default and case retryability/states/transitions/envelope versions/bounds/outcomes/capabilities/spec revision; stable sorted JSON report; missing/extra/mismatch diagnostics; manual-DTO freshness checks and mutants.
exclude: Generating PHP/Dart source; public export/layout decisions; changing P2–P5 behavior; JCS byte oracle; official MCP suite; accepting aliases/unknown rows to make the report green; translating titles/detail strings as parity requirements.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.
Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: The manifest is regenerated from normative sources and checked for zero diff. SDK profiles are assembled from production constants/types and declared capabilities, not copied test JSON. Exact-set means both directions; unknown extra is red. Case-level retryability is compared separately from the code default. All rows include source addresses and input digests. Report ordering is deterministic. Human titles/localization are excluded, while safe context-key sets are included. No reflection/source parser may silently skip an unreadable file. Source generation and network reads are forbidden. A mismatch keeps the item non-green; editing the manifest by hand is forbidden.
guidance: Prefer small language-native profile builders returning plain JSON-compatible maps. Keep the comparator in `conformance/` language-neutral at the data boundary. Print `missing`, `extra`, and field-level `mismatch` arrays. Make one mutant per semantic family so a comparator that only counts rows cannot pass.
deliverables: Generated digest-qualified semantic manifest, actual PHP/Dart profile exporters, deterministic exact-set parity report and proved manual-DTO drift gate.
